alias_mobile_order_category: Assumption retained from previous experiment; no verified equivalence from source
selection_rule: Highest 5-fold mean AP; scenarios within 0.005 or paired-difference SD may prefer P0/P1/P2/P3 if Brier degradation <=0.005. Tuned algorithms within 0.005 AP: lower Brier only if ECE does not worsen; otherwise higher AP. Sigmoid only if AP degradation <=0.005 and both Brier and quantile-bin ECE improve.
scope_resolution: Detailed sections 3.5-3.9 supersede conflicting six-model overview. Repeated 5x3 used for feature/imbalance stability, first five folds for benchmark selection, three folds for tuning. No Agent/LLM/API/UI.
